synonyms: Saga of Tanya the Evil II

name.native: ターニャ・デグレチャフ

node.description:
While Tanya Degurechaff may look like a cute, adorable and innocent little girl, but deep inside, she is a cold-hearted and ruthless contractualist. This side of her is especially evident when she is in battle against her enemies; she shows no remorse as she weaves through a chaotic battleground inflicting maximum damage through whatever means necessary to accomplish her missions. Tanya strongly disapproves of failure and disobedience from her subordinates. She is loyal to her own job and always wants to finish it as soon as possible. Tanya will never let anyone discriminate against her appearance because of how fast she goes through the ranks in the military.

~!Tanya was originally a male salaryman who was murdered by a coworker after he fired them. Tanya was reborn as a young girl living in an alternate universe version of Europe during World War I. At just nine years of age, to avoid conscription into less work, Tanya volunteers for the Empire's Mages Division and is promoted to Second Lieutenant shortly after.!~

name.native: ヴィクトーリヤ・イヴァーノヴナ・セレブリャコーフ

node.description: Viktoriya Ivanovna Serebryakov is a mage and a conscript in the Empire's army, and in the past were a member of Platoon 3 under [Tanya's](https://anilist.co/character/121052) leadership. After that, she joined the new Wing Battalion named "V601" to serve as Tanya's adjutant.

name.native: ハンス・フォン・ゼートゥーア

node.description: Imperial Army General, Chief of Staff. A rationalist boasting enormous knowledge. Cooperates with [Rudersdorf](https://anilist.co/character/121059), Chief of Operations, to plan and implement strategies.

name.native: エーリッヒ・フォン・レルゲン

node.description: A high-ranking officer in the Empire's Military Command, belonging to Strategic Headquarter. He is part of the General Staff's strategic advisory member that deals with the Empire's war tactics. A thoughtful and keen man, he quickly deduces the true nature of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052/Degurechaff-Tanya), calling her a demon. Even so, he trusts her ruthless efficiency to carry out tasks perfectly.

She is the sole daughter of [Anson Sioux](https://anilist.co/character/135048).
~!Mary Sioux is one of the main antagonists of the series, the ultimate rival and the tool used by [Being X](https://anilist.co/character/135044) in order to stabilize a neutral war against [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052). After her father's death, she became rather more vengeful and serious. Her hatred grows when she hears the name "Devil of the Rhine," she will begin to rage but resulting exposing herself in a controlless side. She is the only person who can match Tanya von Degurechaff in many battles.
!~

name.native: マテウス・ヨハン・ヴァイス

node.description: He is the vice captain of the 203rd Aerial Mage Wing, and the captain of the 2nd Aerial Mage Squadron belongs to it.

name.native: クルト・フォン・ルーデルドルフ

node.description: Imperial Army General, Chief of Operations. A wonderful and involved soldier, able to plan out large scale strategies as well as finely tune precise operations towards success. Friend of [Zettour](https://anilist.co/character/121056), Chief of Staff.

Being X is the main antagonist of the Youjo Senki series. It is, in its own words, "God", but [Tanya](https://anilist.co/character/121052) in her first meeting with it labeled it as the devil. Being X is a mysterious being. It claims to be a God, the God of the Bible, the one that gave the 10 commandments to Moses. 

However, there are a number of Gods and Archangels overseeing the world(s), which goes against what is postulated in the First Commandment. Its goal appears to be the increase of the number of faithful people in the world.

node.description: He is a talented mad engineer, inventing many useful weapons during the war.

Rhiner Neumann is serving as the 4th Company Commander of V601 under the command of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052).

name.native: リリーヤ・イヴァノヴァ・タネーチカ

node.description: She is a political officer who just graduated from the academy. Due to the image strategy of the Federation, she was assigned to the liaison officer of Commonwealth Expeditionary Mage Force.

name.native: マクシミリアン・ヨハン・フォン・ウーガ

node.description: Maximilian Johann von Ugar is a classmate and rival of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052) in their class during War College Arc. He hails from a plain family, and had a newborn daughter in 1924. After graduating from War College, their friendship goes on, and Tanya gains personal connections with him, which helps her many times afterwards.

alternative: ヴィルジニオ・カランドロ

node.description: Calandro was one of the rare Ildoan military officers who had served in small-scale conflicts in the colonies. He belongs to the Center Faction in the Royal Ildoan Army administration.
General who undertook the role of the Commander of Southern Continent Expeditionary Corps, which later was upgraded to Army Group Southern Continent.

name.native: サー・アイザック・ダスティン・ドレイク

node.description: Sir Isaac Dustin Drake is a Captain of a Marine Mage Wing

He is a mage colonel of Federation Army. Several years ago, because serving as a mage colonel in the ex-government, he as well as his family were sent to the concentration camps during the Great Purge. In order to content against the Imperial mages, the Politburo released his mage unit and ordered them to fight for the Federation.

name.native: テオパルト・ヴュステマン

node.description: He is the reserve mage company commander of Salamander Kampfgruppe. His company was evaluated good ability and quality but lacks experience by [Weiss](https://anilist.co/character/135058/Weiss-Matheus-Johann).

name.native: エルマー・アーレンス

node.description: He is the tank company commander of Salamander Kampfgruppe. He was recommended by [Lergen](https://anilist.co/character/121058/von-Lergen-Erich), proving his capability as a tank commander to [Tanya](https://anilist.co/character/121052/Degurechaff-Tanya).

He is the self-propelled artillery battalion commander of Salamander Kampfgruppe. He ever served in Rhine Front and tended to improvidently fire all shells out. However, he proved [Tanya](https://anilist.co/character/121052/Degurechaff-Tanya) his capability as an artillery specialist in the first battle of the kampfgruppe.
He is the reinforced infantry battalion vice commander of Salamander Kampfgruppe. He stubbornly defended Thon’s authority during the first battle of the kampfgruppe and irritated Tanya.

name.native: リーンハルト・トーン

node.description: He is the reinforced infantry battalion commander of Salamander Kampfgruppe. During the first battle of the kampfgruppe, he ordered [Tospan](https://anilist.co/character/403715/Tospan-Klaus) to attend the commander’s meeting, went out to scout, and left his infantry unit have no idea what they’re supposed to be doing. Eventually, he is MIA in this battle.

Gassman is a military politician who had experience involving in the colonies wars during his younger days. Nowadays, he’s served mostly at Ildoan central command and has barely been out in the field. He leads the Center Faction which doesn’t stand out much but is the top figure in the Royal Ildoan Army administration. In novel volume 6, he was appointed as the general director of the exercises and conducted the inspection in person, meaning to mediate between the Empire and the countries it is at war with.

node.description: Donald Habergram is the military officer whom the intelligence agency of Allied Kingdom was loyal to, and he took part in many intelligence activities against the Empire during the Great War.
